gates.title: Checkout/Portal are credential-gated, not V1-disabled
gates.proof: Absent keys yield 503 with zero network calls. Retained synthetic keys cause two captured Stripe calls even with manual-mode negative canary. No real call was made. Separate static inventory also finds the organization-deletion subscription cancellation helper gated only by STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; that helper was not runtime-tested and no organization was deleted.
gates.fix: One server-authoritative billing policy defaults to manual/off; payment routes return disabled before parsing/payment/provider work even if credentials remain. Apply policy to the subscription cancellation helper and define legacy-subscription handling explicitly. Test direct URL/API access, not just hidden buttons.

gates.title: Webhook can still automatically change packages when configured
gates.proof: Absent webhook secret returns 503 before DB. With valid synthetic signature and keys, actual POST calls entitlement RPC with p_is_upgrade=true despite manual-mode canary.
gates.fix: In V1 the webhook must cause no entitlement/subscription/quota/suspension write; disable before DB effects. Define safe ack/rejection behavior and record ignored deliveries without upgrades. Gate legacy Stripe RPC invocation paths as well.

gates.title: Payment success UI remains query-driven
gates.proof: Actual settings component emits payment-success message solely from billing=ok, with no payment receipt or release policy check.
gates.fix: Hide/disable payment entry points, portal and payment success/cancel UI in V1. Expose manual account/plan support text. In V2 success must rely on authoritative receipt; URL query is not payment evidence.

gates.title: Manual package changes need attributable audit history
gates.proof: Actual platform identity ignores user_metadata. Actual SQL denies non-admin and permits fixture-admin. Provided action/function writes plan/quota, but no before/after/actor/reason audit insert is present; external/deployed audit trigger is unverified.
gates.fix: Use verified platform-admin identity and server-controlled values; atomically record actor, org, before/after quotas/plan, reason, timestamp, correlation ID and authorization result. Prove non-admin, cross-tenant and replay behavior.

gates.title: Manual quota action and migration RPC signatures disagree
gates.proof: Actual action sends p_monthly_video_quota; sole checked-in admin_update_organization definition has four parameters. Embedded PostgreSQL reports function does not exist when called with the action arguments. Deployed schema may differ and was not inspected.
gates.fix: Deliver reviewed additive migration for the exact RPC contract, preserve privilege/admin checks and add atomic audit. Test migration upgrade and actual action -> PostgREST -> PG path before pilot.
